Part of the spread is a UTC-versus-local conversion error circulating uncorrected (13:08 UTC = 07:08 MDT, published as both). SU-BND's unexplained 68-minute Provo->Provo sortie on 5 Sept has an exact twin: SU-BGM flew a 55-minute Provo->Provo loop on 10 Apr 2025 - the signature of a post-maintenance functional check flight. If the September loop is anomalous, consistency requires treating the April one the same way. Duncan Aviation's Egyptian Air Force account dates to 1999.

From 23 May to 13 Sept 2025 - 113 continuous days - a foreign-registered jet was parked at this field, and in those 113 days SU-BND flew exactly twice, both Provo->Provo round-robins.
